summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or Black, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, using the is_terminal check and documented as described in the spec; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title with the title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was committed. Formatting and test results are unverified.
